program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (/ (rows g) 2))
                  (hw (/ (cols g) 2)))
             (build-grid hh
                         hw
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((tl (at g r c))
                                (br (at g (+ r hh) (+ c hw)))
                                (bl (at g (+ r hh) c))
                                (tr (at g r (+ c hw)))
                                (v tl)
                                (v (if (!= br 0) br v))
                                (v (if (!= bl 0) bl v))
                                (v (if (!= tr 0) tr v)))
                           v))))))
